item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/Apr/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will continue to bring hot weather to Guangdong tomorrow. Meanwhile, an easterly airstream will affect the coast of eastern Guangdong gradually. Under the influence of a trough of low pressure, there will be thundery showers over southern China in the next few days. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coastal areas midweek next week. It will be brighter over the region.
